rule: A15 post hoc / exploratory follow-up F2 (RESEARCH_TREE D18). §8 gate: the single candidate F2 (H1 + artefact-only B-loo W7-03 on M2(f=1)) is eligible iff its paired validation Δ̄_lin vs G* (H1/M0, the W1 look's G-star) has CI lower bound > 0 (L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum); m = 1, so σ·√(2 ln m) = 0 and the one-SE rule is trivial. P1 (M6:H1+Bloo/M2(f=1)) is descriptive and is never selected here. The F2 question is the validated cost of the safer variant, F2 − P1, read as Δ̄_lin(F2 − H1) − Δ̄_lin(P1 − H1) on the identical primary-cell lines (exact point estimate; no CI from the harness). No claim that F2 beats P1; it never replaces T1/T2 or the headline, and no test evaluation follows.
